name: Traverse
long_description:
Humans control the future because we are the most intelligent species on Earth. We believe AI will soon change that, and that our control is at risk. As a research lab, we study AI alignment and model psychology to ensure these systems have our best interests at heart. We post-train models for companies on the same principle, so that the models they rely on are their own and act in their interest. 
We are a small team of researchers and engineers, and we’re hiring!
one_liner: On a mission to keep the future in human hands.
